mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_accounting_rule_line (id, bundle_ver_id, instruction_type, line_no, line_code, amount_source_code, owner_role, account_code, balance_bucket, entry_side, required_flag, create_time) VALUES (#{line.id}, #{line.bundleVerId}, #{line.instructionType}, #{line.lineNo}, #{line.lineCode}, #{line.amountSourceCode}, #{line.ownerRole}, #{line.accountCode}, #{line.balanceBucket}, #{line.entrySide}, #{line.requiredFlag}, #{line.createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, bundle_ver_id, instruction_type, line_no, line_code, amount_source_code, owner_role, account_code, balance_bucket, entry_side, required_flag, create_time FROM t_accounting_rule_line WHERE bundle_ver_id = #{bundleVerId} ORDER BY instruction_type, line_no
